name: definition-year-number-collision-iso-end
description: Invalid definition. ISO 8601 week years numbered by 'end'. ISO 2016 ends 2017-01-01 and ISO 2017 ends 2017-12-31, so both get the number 2017. Only code and path are asserted; details.years is not, because the spec only says it lists the first affected years.
